description: Most fitness bands make you check a screen constantly. ZAVYOO is different — it is a screenless fitness band that works silently in the background, collecting deep health data 24 hours a day so you can focus on what matters. Why screenless? Removing the screen does three things — it extends battery life to 30+ days, eliminates distracting notifications and makes the band lighter and more comfortable than anything else on your wrist. What ZAVYOO tracks: Heart Rate HRV for recovery Blood Oxygen SpO2 Blood Pressure Stress Levels Sleep Stages (deep, light, REM) Steps & Calories Women's Health GPS routes Your health in one app: Everything syncs automatically to the free ZAVYOO app on iOS and Android. View daily health scores, weekly trends, sleep reports and smart alarm — all in one clean dashboard. Whether you are an athlete tracking recovery, a working professional monitoring stress, or someone building a healthier lifestyle — ZAVYOO gives you the data to make better decisions every day.
